name: Find The Powers [160]
desc:
Welcome to Find The Auras! Search through 7 maps and collect insane Auras! Equip your favorite Aura and show it to your friends! 

Join our group for free LEGENDARY aura!

🎮 How To Play:
🔎 Explore the maps to find all of the hidden Auras
🏃 Use sprint to complete obbies easier
☯️ Equip Auras and flex them to your friends
🏆 Find them all to win!

Some Auras are very well hidden. Find the Auras with friends and meet new friends along the way!

185 Auras
7 Maps

Premium benefit: Exclusive Aura!

Let us know in the group if you find any bugs.
